body: Did you miss NorfolkJS last week? Tim Baines walked the room through Resume.js — a data-driven resume page that takes a single JSON file and renders a full HTML resume from it, served off GitHub Pages. Vanilla JavaScript, no frameworks: just fetch, ES Modules, and a modular architecture.
Ryan McGovern followed with his own approach to the same problem, so the room got two solutions at two different experience levels — which was the whole point of the format.

quote.text: Last year he wasn't even really writing anything in JavaScript. I was impressed with how he actually read through Eloquent JavaScript and implemented higher order functions like .map() without vibe coding it. He actually took the time to learn it.
